scope: Real CPU segment PCS only; CPU capture, GKR, composition and truth proofs remain outside this resident interval. No full-block speedup claim.
change: Absorb sorted low-height columns into unfinalized Blake2s prefix states at their own native height. Lift the state including pending words before absorbing the next group. Finalize only at the original tree height. Branch hashing, leaf word order, domain prefix and transcript are unchanged.

qualification.fresh_receiver: Reference raw PCS output is from the parent fresh-prefix-accepted run. Exact equality preserves that proof; no second CPU producer regeneration was required.
qualification.sanitizers: Not repeated: no new kernel or device indexing; host scheduling of existing qualified seeded kernel changed. Real-size parity is the focused gate.

memory.derivation: Maximum simultaneous previous+next states: (2^19+2^21)*96 bytes on the three mixed-height trees. The composition-only tree needs no prefix scratch. Allocations/frees are ordered on the same stream, all error paths release pending scratch.
memory.accounting_limit: Existing device_bytes counter excludes this stream-internal temporary memory. Default CUDA pool reservation/fragmentation and full process device highwater were not measured. Follow-up should admit an explicit reusable scratch arena and account its reservation.

measurement_limits: Nine repeats are separate helper processes; they warm device clocks and file cache, not a persistent CUDA context.
Resident timing includes prefix kernels/stream allocation ordering, excludes coefficient import and initial H2D.
Parent CPU workload may overlap; this is a real-segment checkpoint, not a quiet full-block A/B.
The external-helper path still takes seconds and must be replaced with an in-process resident adapter.
